about.heading: Who Am I?
about.paragraph1: I'm a Software Engineer focused on building reliable, scalable products across frontend and backend. I have 5+ years of experience working across the software development lifecycle, from product discovery and architecture to implementation, testing, deployment and observability.
about.paragraph2: I currently work at Shopee, building technology for large-scale logistics and customs operations, contributing to systems that process millions of shipments every month. I'm particularly interested in distributed systems, developer productivity, observability and AI-powered engineering.
about.paragraph3: I belive that innovation isn't necessarily creating something new and from scratch. If we facilitate the life of at least one person this will already be innovation.
